order_baseline_semantic_correction.scientific_rationale: Book order (u first mentioned before v) is a directional prior, not a balanced binary classifier. Calling it 'Accuracy' counts true negatives across non-prerequisites merely because v precedes u, while obscuring that book order recovers 96.5% of true prerequisite dependencies forward. Furthermore, comparing 0.7719 to the 0.700 or 0.875 precision/accuracy of extracted edges on 7-8 decided pairs is comparing decided-pair precision against full-benchmark binary accuracy.
